title: Generic local constancy reflected by finite module direct image
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $f:X\to Y$ a finite morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], with $Y$ Noetherian, and $F$ an etale $\Lambda$-module sheaf. Let $V\subseteq Y$ be a dense open on which $f_*F$ is finite locally constant [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant]. There is a dense open $U\subseteq V$ of $Y$ such that $F|_{f^{-1}(U)}$ is locally constant [def-constructible-locally-constant]. No assertion is made on the complement of this open, and no finite generation assertion is made about F.

proof.text: Reduce Y without changing etale local constancy, restrict to V, remove component intersections, and choose affine integral dense opens in the finitely many components. Apply generic finite-algebra splitting to the finite inverse image of each affine and shrink again. The reduced source is a finite disjoint union of universal-homeomorphism pieces after a surjective finite etale cover; reduction lifts these pieces to the unreduced source.

Finite exchange identifies the direct image after this cover with the pullback of the finite locally constant sheaf in the hypothesis. Each component direct image is a retract of this ambient sheaf, by projection to a factor in the finite product of sections on the disjoint pieces. Pullback preserves local constancy and finite stalks.

For a retract with projector e of an ambient finite locally constant module sheaf M, its image is ker(1-e). On a common trivializing etale cover the morphism 1-e is locally induced by a linear map because the ambient module is finitely generated. Its kernel is the constant module sheaf on the kernel of that map. Thus the retract is locally constant, without assuming the coefficient ring Noetherian. Transport through the universal homeomorphisms to the source pieces and compose trivializing etale covers. Glue over the disjoint affine opens; their finite union gives U <= V dense in Y. The empty target and empty fibres satisfy the same construction vacuously.

theorem exists_dense_open_locallyConstant_of_finite_lowerStar_module
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (V : Y.Opens) (hV : Dense (V : Set Y))
    (h : IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf
      ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) V.ι).obj
        ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj F))) :
    ∃ U : Y.Opens, U ≤ V ∧ Dense (U : Set Y) ∧
      IsLocallyConstantSheaf
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj F)
